facebook.content_angle: How to price your East Auckland home right the first time — why the wrong starting price costs sellers more than they realise
facebook.post_text:
Pricing your home wrong from day one is one of the most expensive decisions you can make. 💸

Most sellers either price too high hoping to negotiate down — or too low thinking it will spark a bidding war. Both strategies can seriously cost you.

👉 An overpriced home sits on the market, loses momentum, and buyers start wondering what's wrong with it
👉 Once a property goes stale, price drops signal desperation — and negotiating power disappears fast
👉 Homes priced strategically from day one attract more competition and stronger offers

The right price isn't about what you want — it's about what the market will reward. 🏡

✔️ A strong pricing strategy is built on real local data, not gut feel
✔️ Understanding what comparable East Auckland homes are actually selling for right now is the starting point
✔️ Getting this right before you list — not after — is where premium results begin

This is exactly the conversation I have with every seller before a property hits the market.

Are you confident your home would be priced to perform in today's East Auckland market?
